# Freak Circus Hub — Full Reference
> The definitive fan archive for The Freak Circus, an indie psychological horror visual novel by Garula. Character guides, all endings explained, walkthroughs, hidden lore, and community theories.

## About
Freak Circus Hub (freak-circus.com) is the most comprehensive fan-maintained database for The Freak Circus. We document every character, ending, route, hidden trigger, and community theory with verified evidence and cross-referenced sources. Our content is based on community testing, data mining, and cross-platform verification across 12+ contributors.

## Characters

### Pierrot
- [Pierrot Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/pierrot)
- Melancholic clown, first route players typically encounter
- Key mechanic: Comfort / Confess dialogue system
- Loop-aware: references previous playthroughs in Scene 14 after 4th playthrough
- Garden scene gains hidden "Say Nothing" option after failing route once
- Secret ending: Eternal Silence (refuse all dialogue in final act, 4-min black screen)
- Post-credits scene references player's real-world playtime
- Personality: withdrawn, observant, emotionally dependent, yandere tendencies
- First encounter: The Garden, Day 1

### Harlequin
- [Harlequin Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/harlequin)
- Chaotic performer with unpredictable energy
- Key mechanic: Comedy / Aggression choice system
- Fractured Route unlocks after failing main route (Scene 4 aggressive + Scene 9 comedic contradiction)
- "You again" line on 4th playthrough — not in script files, confirmed by multiple players
- 7 undocumented hidden scenes in Fractured Route
- Mirror Hall connection: reflections swap after completing both Pierrot and Harlequin routes
- Main ending: Harlequin's Laughter. Secret ending: Fractured Smile
- First encounter: The Stage, Day 1

### The Doctor
- [The Doctor Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/doctor)
- Circus physician with unsettling clinical knowledge
- Key mechanic: Hidden Medical Files (5 scattered across scenes)
- Precognitive dialogue: describes White Room ending in Scene 7, 3 routes before accessible
- Medical files contain character profiles in clinical terminology (File 5 is about the player)
- Memory Route: find all 5 files, fail main route, mirror connection appears in Scene 9
- Unused voice lines suggest original primary antagonist role
- Main ending: Doctor's Note. Secret ending: White Room
- First encounter: Medical Tent, Day 1

### Columbina
- [Columbina Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/columbina)
- Ballerina with the most complex route mechanics
- Key mechanic: Three-Loop Alignment (graceful → precise → silent)
- Any deviation resets to Loop 1 with no notification
- Hallway gains 4th door after 3 perfect loops, 5th door leads to memory fragment
- Memory fragment references events from ALL routes, including unplayed ones
- Cross-route awareness: experiences entire circus as single continuous narrative
- Main ending: Final Curtain. Secret ending: Columbina's Truth
- First encounter: The Hallway, Day 1

### Jester
- [Jester Character Guide](https://freak-circus.com/characters/jester)
- Mysterious trickster, no playable route as of v0.2
- Appears Day 2 backstage
- Aware of game's looping structure, speaks with unsettling familiarity
- True identity unknown
- Threat level: ????
- Community theory: may be the architect of the circus itself

### Ticket Taker
- [Ticket Taker Guide](https://freak-circus.com/ticket-taker)
- Gatekeeper of the Freak Circus
- No character model under mask (confirmed by data mining, modding causes NULL_FACE_EXCEPTION)
- Key mechanic: Pink Ticket (spiritual anchor, required for Day 2+ progression)
- Mirror scene: player's reflection shows wearing Ticket Taker's porcelain mask
- Height 188cm matches Doctor exactly; never appear in same scene
- Paranormal Class III classification
- No playable route; empty romance voice files suggest planned but cut content
- First encounter: The Raining Cafe, Day 1

## Endings
- [All Endings Guide](https://freak-circus.com/endings): Complete catalog of 8+ endings with unlock conditions, difficulty ratings, and route dependencies.

### Standard Endings
- **Grand Finale**: Default ending. Complete any main route without special conditions.
- **Smile For Me**: Pierrot's main ending. Accept offer in garden scene, Act III.
- **Doctor's Note**: Collect 3+ medical files, accept diagnosis in Scene 12.

### Secret Endings
- **Eternal Silence**: Refuse all dialogue in final act. Screen black for 4 minutes. Breaks fourth wall.
- **Columbina's Truth**: 3 perfect loops required. Reveals circus is purgatorial loop.
- **White Room**: Find all 5 medical files, trigger mirror connection, ask about white room.

### Corrupted Endings
- **Corrupted Data**: Found in unused game files. Unlock conditions unknown.
- **Fractured Smile**: Harlequin's secret ending via Fractured Route.

## Key Technical Facts
- The Freak Circus is a free indie psychological horror visual novel on itch.io
- Built in Ren'Py, available for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android
- Current version: v0.2 Prototype (last updated 2026-02-22)
- 8+ confirmed endings across standard, secret, and corrupted categories
- Replay-aware mechanics: characters reference previous playthroughs
- Hidden counter at save file offset 0x4A20 affects dialogue across all builds
- Counter value 4 triggers Pierrot's replay-aware dialogue regardless of current route
- Ticket Taker has no character model under mask (NULL_FACE_EXCEPTION on mod)
- Doctor's Scene 7 precognitive dialogue confirmed across all save slots
- Data miners discovered references to 13th ending in build 1.04 (partially accessible)
- Build 1.04 contains unused voice lines where Doctor speaks without clinical detachment
